-- Krynn Native UI v0.8.10: Centered ASCII viewport, MSDP HUD and room look-output capture. -- The Room tab parses only the contents section after [ Exits: ... ]. KrynnNativeUI = KrynnNativeUI or {} local K = KrynnNativeUI if K.shutdown then pcall(K.shutdown) end K.version='0.8.10'; K.handlers={}; K.panel='player'; K.mapMode='ascii'; K.mapLegend=false K.visible=true; K.sidebarWidth=435; K.mapSplit=44; K.initialized=false; K.warnings={} -- Chat History is an alternative view INSIDE the same-sized right sidebar. -- Messages are retained only for this Mudlet session (up to 1200 lines). K.activeView='game'; K.chatFilter='all'; K.chatHistory={}; K.chatMax=1200; K.chatUnread=0; K.chatFlashOn=false; K.chatFlashTimer=nil; K.historyBatchCounts={}; K.historyBatchActive=false K.resizeWidthDrag=nil; K.resizeSplitDrag=nil -- Only store UI dimensions in the local Mudlet profile; no MUD data is saved. local layoutFile=getMudletHomeDir()..'/KrynnNativeUI_layout.txt' local function readLayout() local f=io.open(layoutFile,'r');if not f then return end local contents=f:read('*a');f:close() local w,split=contents:match('^(%d+)%s+(%d+)') if w then K.sidebarWidth=math.max(310,math.min(800,tonumber(w))) end if split then K.mapSplit=math.max(28,math.min(67,tonumber(split))) end end local function saveLayout() local f=io.open(layoutFile,'w') if f then f:write(K.sidebarWidth..' '..K.mapSplit..'\n');f:close() end end readLayout() K.panX=0; K.panY=0; K.panDrag=nil K.graphX=0; K.graphY=0; K.graphZoom=22; K.graphDrag=nil; K.graphLastRoom=nil -- Session-local protocol observations, never saved or loaded from an external map. K.knownExits={}; K.mapRoomCache={} -- Each visible occurrence stays separate, including identical NPC descriptions. K.roomContents={objects={},npcs={},roomVnum=nil,seen=false} K.roomCapture=false; K.roomLines=0; K.roomWidgets={} K.roomSelected=nil; K.roomTargetOverrides={} -- AFFECTS payload contains SPELL_LIKE_AFFECTS and AFFECTED_BY sub-arrays. -- A clock is maintained per occurrence, updated from server duration values. K.affectsClock={}; K.affectWidgets={}; K.affectSignature=nil; K.affectsTimer=nil local function E(x) return tostring(x==nil and '' or x):gsub('&','&'):gsub('<','<'):gsub('>','>'):gsub('"','"') end local function field(t,...) if type(t)~='table' then return nil end for _,k in ipairs({...}) do if t[k]~=nil then return t[k] end end end local function decode(x) if type(x)~='string' then return x end local s=x:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$') if s:sub(1,1)~='{' and s:sub(1,1)~='[' then return x end if yajl and yajl.to_value then local ok,v=pcall(yajl.to_value,s); if ok and type(v)=='table' then return v end end if json and json.decode then local ok,v=pcall(json.decode,s); if ok and type(v)=='table' then return v end end return x end local function V(key) return type(msdp)=='table' and decode(msdp[key]) or nil end local function any(...) for _,k in ipairs({...}) do local v=V(k); if v~=nil and v~='' then return v end end end local function n(x) return tonumber(x) or 0 end local function pct(x,y) if n(y)<=0 then return 0 end return math.max(0, math.min(100, n(x)*100/n(y))) end local function pretty(k) return tostring(k):gsub('_',' '):gsub('(%l)(%u)','%1 %2'):lower():gsub('^%l',string.upper) end local function scalar(x) if type(x)=='table' then return nil end return tostring(x==nil and '' or x) end local C={bg='#181818',card='#282828',line='#4d4d4d',muted='#b3b3b3',text='#eee9df',hp='#28b765',move='#4eb9d7',psp='#4089ee',xp='#d6a41d'} local function line(k,v) if v==nil or v=='' or type(v)=='table' then return '' end return ''..E(k)..''..E(v)..'' end local function tableRows(rows) return ''..table.concat(rows)..'
' end local function card(title,body,tag) return '
'..E(title)..''..(tag and ' '..E(tag)..'' or '')..'
'..body..'

' end local function bar(v,m,color) if not v or not m or n(m)<=0 then return '' end local p=pct(v,m) return '
' end local function unavailable(name) return '
No '..E(name)..' received through the MUD protocol.
' end local function collection(t) t=decode(t) if type(t)~='table' then return nil end if #t>0 then return t end for _,k in ipairs({'MEMBERS','members','GROUP','group','QUESTS','quests','LIST','list','AFFECTS','affects','DATA','data'}) do local sub=decode(t[k]); if type(sub)=='table' then if #sub>0 then return sub end end end local out={}; for k,v in pairs(t) do if type(v)=='table' then if not v.NAME and not v.name then v._key=k end; out[#out+1]=v end end if #out>0 then table.sort(out,function(a,b) return tostring(field(a,'NAME','name','_key') or '')'.. ''.. ''.. ''.. '
'..E(label)..''..E(playerText(shown))..'
' end local function webStats(labels) local parts={''} for i=1,#labels,3 do parts[#parts+1]='' for j=i,i+2 do local k=labels[j] parts[#parts+1]= k and webStat(k[1],k[2]) or '' end parts[#parts+1]='' end parts[#parts+1]='
' return table.concat(parts) end local function webInfoLine(label,value,highlight) if value==nil or value=='' then return '' end local color=highlight or '#f0eae2' return ''..E(label)..''.. ''..E(playerText(value))..'' end local function renderPlayer() local name=any('CHARACTER_NAME'); local lvl=V('LEVEL');local cls=V('CLASS');local race=V('RACE') if not name and not lvl then return unavailable('character data') end name=playerText(name or 'Character') local first,last=name:match('^(%S+)%s+(.+)$') local title=first and (''..E(first)..' '..E(last)..'') or ''..E(name)..'' local subtitle={} if lvl~=nil then subtitle[#subtitle+1]='Level '..playerText(lvl) end if race~=nil and tostring(race)~='' then subtitle[#subtitle+1]=playerText(race) end if cls~=nil and tostring(cls)~='' then subtitle[#subtitle+1]=playerText(cls) end local abilities={} for _,key in ipairs({'STR','DEX','CON','INT','WIS','CHA'}) do abilities[#abilities+1]={key,V(key)} end local saves={ {'Fort',any('FORTITUDE','FORTITUDE_SAVE','FORT_SAVE')}, {'Refl',any('REFLEX','REFLEX_SAVE','REF_SAVE')}, {'Will',any('WILLPOWER','WILL_SAVE','WILLPOWER_SAVE')} } local lines={} for _,p in ipairs({ {'Position',any('POSITION')}, {'Attack',any('ATTACK_BONUS','ATTACK')}, {'Armor Class',any('AC','ARMOR_CLASS')}, {'Alignment',any('ALIGNMENT')}, {'Damage',any('DAMAGE_BONUS')}, {'Gold',any('MONEY')}, {'Practice',any('PRACTICE')}, {'World time',any('WORLD_TIME')} }) do local tint=p[1]=='Alignment' and '#d8bc82' or nil lines[#lines+1]=webInfoLine(p[1],p[2],tint) end return '
'.. ''..title..'
'.. ''..E(table.concat(subtitle,' · '))..'
'.. webStats(abilities)..'
'..webStats(saves).. ''..table.concat(lines)..'
' end -- Preserve the existing group frames but tighten them into MMO-style bars. -- Never infer another member's HP: only show values the server provided. local function partyResource(label,value,maximum,color) local v=tonumber(value); local m=tonumber(maximum) local textValue=(v and m and m>0) and (tostring(value)..' / '..tostring(maximum)) or '—' local part={''..E(label)..': '..E(textValue)..''} local fraction=(v and m and m>0) and pct(v,m) or 0 local fill=math.floor(fraction+0.5) part[#part+1]='' if fill>0 then part[#part+1]='' end if fill<100 then part[#part+1]='' end part[#part+1]='
' return table.concat(part) end local function groupIsLeader(v) if v==true or v==1 then return true end local s=tostring(v or ''):lower() return s=='true' or s=='1' or s=='yes' or s=='leader' end -- Combat fields are percentage-style health, not reliable absolute hit points. -- Keep the server's distinct group-resource values when they are available. local function combatHealth(value,maximum) local v,m=tonumber(value),tonumber(maximum) if not v then return '—',nil end if m and m>0 then local percent=pct(v,m) return tostring(math.floor(percent+0.5))..'%',percent end -- Some Krynn servers send only the current percentage. return tostring(math.floor(math.max(0,math.min(100,v))+0.5))..'%',math.max(0,math.min(100,v)) end local function combatBar(value,maximum,color) local shown,percent=combatHealth(value,maximum) local fill=percent and math.floor(percent+0.5) or 0 return 'Health: '..E(shown)..''.. ''.. (fill>0 and '' or '').. (fill<100 and '' or '')..'
' end local function combatName(value) if value==nil then return '' end local name=playerText(value):match('^%s*(.-)%s*$') or '' if name=='0' or name:lower()=='none' or name:lower()=='null' then return '' end return name end local function sameCombatName(a,b) a=combatName(a):lower():gsub('[^%w]+',' '):match('^%s*(.-)%s*$') or '' b=combatName(b):lower():gsub('[^%w]+',' '):match('^%s*(.-)%s*$') or '' return a~='' and b~='' and (a==b or a:match('^%S+')==b:match('^%S+')) end local function renderGroup() local html={} local target=combatName(any('OPPONENT_NAME')) local targetHP,targetMax=V('OPPONENT_HEALTH'),V('OPPONENT_HEALTH_MAX') local targetLevel=V('OPPONENT_LEVEL') local tank=combatName(any('TANK_NAME')) local tankHP,tankMax=V('TANK_HEALTH'),V('TANK_HEALTH_MAX') -- The target is first and uses the same compact resource-card look as party frames. if target~='' then local level=(tonumber(targetLevel) and tonumber(targetLevel)>0) and 'Lv '..E(targetLevel)..'' or '' html[#html+1]=''.. '
'.. ''.. '
'.. ''..E(target)..'TARGET'.. (level~='' and '   '..level or '')..'
'.. '
'..combatBar(targetHP,targetMax,'#b95050')..'

' else html[#html+1]='No current combat target.
' end local src=any('GROUP');local entries=collection(src) if not entries then if tank~='' then html[#html+1]=''.. '
'.. ''..E(tank)..' '.. 'TANK
'.. combatBar(tankHP,tankMax,'#d38a56')..'

' end html[#html+1]=''..((type(src)=='table' and next(src)==nil) and 'You are not currently in a group.' or 'No structured group members received.')..'' return table.concat(html) end local selfName=tostring(any('CHARACTER_NAME') or ''):lower() local tankMatched=false for _,m in ipairs(entries) do local name,hp,hm,mv,mm,level,formation,leader if type(m)=='table' then name=field(m,'NAME','name','CHARACTER_NAME','character_name','SHORT','short','_key') or 'Group member' hp=field(m,'HEALTH','health','HP','hp') hm=field(m,'HEALTH_MAX','health_max','MAX_HEALTH','max_health','MAX_HP','max_hp') mv=field(m,'MOVEMENT','movement','MOVE','move') mm=field(m,'MOVEMENT_MAX','movement_max','MAX_MOVE','max_move') level=field(m,'LEVEL','level') formation=field(m,'FORMATION','formation','POSITION','position') leader=groupIsLeader(field(m,'LEADER','leader','IS_LEADER','is_leader')) elseif type(m)=='string' then name=m end if name then local isSelf=selfName~='' and tostring(name):lower()==selfName if isSelf then hp=hp or V('HEALTH'); hm=hm or V('HEALTH_MAX') mv=mv or V('MOVEMENT'); mm=mm or V('MOVEMENT_MAX') level=level or V('LEVEL') end local isTank=sameCombatName(name,tank) if isTank then tankMatched=true end local tags={} if isTank then tags[#tags+1]='TANK' end if leader then tags[#tags+1]='LEADER' end if level~=nil then tags[#tags+1]='Lv '..E(level)..'' end if formation~=nil and tostring(formation)~='' then tags[#tags+1]=''..E(formation)..'' end local resources=''.. ''.. ''.. '
'..partyResource('HP',hp,hm,'#34845a')..''..partyResource('Move',mv,mm,'#317e9b')..'
' if isTank and tankHP~=nil then -- Separate the tank's MSDP percentage from group members' actual HP. resources=resources..'
'..combatBar(tankHP,tankMax,'#d38a56') end html[#html+1]=''.. ''.. '
'.. ''.. ''.. ''.. '
'..E(playerText(name))..''..table.concat(tags,'   ')..'
'..resources..'

' end end if tank~='' and not tankMatched then -- The group payload can omit the current tank, e.g. another player or NPC. html[#html+1]=''.. '
'.. ''..E(tank)..' TANK'.. '
'..combatBar(tankHP,tankMax,'#d38a56')..'

' end return table.concat(html) end local clearScrollable -- The server's AFFECTS table is NOT a flat collection: -- { SPELL_LIKE_AFFECTS = {{NAME, LOCATION, MODIFIER, TYPE, DURATION}, ...}, -- AFFECTED_BY = {{NAME, DESC}, ...} } -- The previous generic collection() missed both nested arrays. local function affectList(data,upper,lower) local list=decode(field(data,upper,lower)) if type(list)~='table' then return nil end local out={} for _,a in ipairs(list) do out[#out+1]=decode(a) end -- Some MSDP decoders present a 1-based array with string numeric keys. if #out==0 then local keys={} for k,v in pairs(list) do if tonumber(k) and type(v)=='table' then keys[#keys+1]=k end end table.sort(keys,function(a,b)return tonumber(a)0 then for _,a in ipairs(data) do direct[#direct+1]=a end else for _,v in pairs(data) do if type(v)=='table' and field(v,'NAME','name','SPELL','spell','DURATION','duration')~=nil then direct[#direct+1]=v end end end if #direct>0 then for _,a in ipairs(direct) do append(a,'spell') end return out,'known' end if next(data)==nil then return {},'known' end return nil,'unknown' end -- The C server decrements durations once every 6 seconds, and reports -- whole rounds. A second-precision display therefore is approximate. function K.syncAffectsClock() local entries,format=affectEntries() if format~='known' then return end local old=K.affectsClock or {} local nextClock={} local now=os.time() for _,a in ipairs(entries) do if a.kind=='spell' and a.duration and a.duration>=0 then local previous=old[a.key] if previous and previous.rounds==a.duration then nextClock[a.key]=previous else -- Includes the not-yet-completed six-second server round. nextClock[a.key]={rounds=a.duration,deadline=now+(a.duration+1)*6} end end end K.affectsClock=nextClock end local function durationDisplay(a) if a.duration==nil then return '—' end if a.duration<0 then return 'Permanent' end local clock=(K.affectsClock or {})[a.key] local seconds=math.max(0,math.floor((clock and clock.deadline or os.time()+a.duration*6)-os.time())) local hours=math.floor(seconds/3600) local minutes=math.floor(seconds/60)%60 local remaining=seconds%60 if hours>0 then return string.format('~%d:%02d:%02d',hours,minutes,remaining) end return string.format('~%02d:%02d',math.floor(seconds/60),remaining) end local function affectText(a) local function display(x) return x==nil and '—' or tostring(x) end local modifier=display(a.modifier) local m=tonumber(a.modifier) if m and m>0 then modifier='+'..modifier end return ''..E(a.name)..''.. '
'.. 'Location: '..E(display(a.location))..''.. '   |   Modifier: '..E(modifier)..''.. '   |   Duration: '..E(durationDisplay(a))..'' end function K.clearAffectWidgets() for _,widget in ipairs(K.affectWidgets or {}) do pcall(function() widget:hide();widget:delete() end) end K.affectWidgets={};K.affectSignature=nil end -- Native Geyser labels: separate entries like the Room panel, but no buttons. -- Tick updates change the text in place, preserving scroll position. function K.renderAffectsPanel() if not K.initialized or not K.visible then return end local entries,state=affectEntries() local signature=state if state=='known' then for _,a in ipairs(entries) do signature=signature..'|'..a.key end end if K.affectSignature~=signature then clearScrollable('info') K.clearAffectWidgets() local y=5 local function addCard(html,height) local label=Geyser.Label:new({name='KrynnNativeUI_Affect_'..tostring(#K.affectWidgets+1), x=5,y=y,width='100%-29',height=height},K.infoScroll) label:setStyleSheet('QLabel { background-color:#292f35; color:#eeeeee; border:1px solid #4a525b; padding:6px; qproperty-alignment: AlignTop; }') label:echo(html) K.affectWidgets[#K.affectWidgets+1]=label y=y+height+5 end if state=='missing' then addCard('Waiting for the MUD to send AFFECTS data.',41) elseif state=='unknown' then addCard('AFFECTS data received in an unrecognized format.',44) elseif #entries==0 then addCard('No active effects.',40) else for _,a in ipairs(entries) do addCard(affectText(a),56) end end -- Bottom spacer makes the content scroll even on Mudlet builds that -- derive the ScrollBox extent from its children. local spacer=Geyser.Label:new({name='KrynnNativeUI_Affect_spacer', x=0,y=y,width=1,height=4},K.infoScroll) spacer:setStyleSheet('background-color:transparent;border:0;') K.affectWidgets[#K.affectWidgets+1]=spacer K.affectSignature=signature elseif state=='known' and #entries>0 then for i,a in ipairs(entries) do local label=K.affectWidgets[i] if label then label:echo(affectText(a)) end end end end function K.startAffectsTimer() if K.affectsTimer then pcall(killTimer,K.affectsTimer);K.affectsTimer=nil end if not K.initialized then return end K.affectsTimer=tempTimer(1,function() K.affectsTimer=nil if not K.initialized then return end if K.visible and K.panel=='affects' then K.renderAffectsPanel() end K.startAffectsTimer() end) end -- v0.8 Quest tracker cleanup: retain the existing simple list and its -- actual values. No invented objectives, progress bars, or expand controls. local function renderQuests() local data=any('QUESTS','QUEST','QUEST_INFO') local entries=collection(data) if not entries and type(data)=='table' and field(data,'NAME','name','TITLE','title','QUEST_NAME','quest_name') then entries={data} end if not entries then if type(data)=='table' and next(data)==nil then return 'No quests are currently tracked.' end return unavailable('structured quest list') end local out={} for _,q in ipairs(entries) do if type(q)=='table' then local name=field(q,'NAME','name','TITLE','title','QUEST_NAME','quest_name','_key') or 'Quest' local status=field(q,'STATUS','status','STATE','state') local progress=field(q,'PROGRESS','progress') if type(progress)=='table' then local current=field(progress,'CURRENT','current','DONE','done') local total=field(progress,'TOTAL','total','REQUIRED','required') progress=(current~=nil and total~=nil) and (tostring(current)..' / '..tostring(total)) or nil end local objective=field(q,'OBJECTIVE','objective','GOAL','goal') local description=field(q,'DESCRIPTION','description','DETAILS','details') local typ=field(q,'TYPE','type') local info={} local function addLine(label,v) if v~=nil and v~='' and type(v)~='table' then info[#info+1]=''..E(label)..': '..E(v)..'' end end addLine('Status',status) addLine('Progress',progress) addLine('Objective',objective) if description~=objective then addLine('Details',description) end addLine('Type',typ) local rows={} for _,v in ipairs(info) do rows[#rows+1]='
'..v..'
' end out[#out+1]=''.. '
'.. ''..E(name)..''.. (#rows>0 and '
'..table.concat(rows) or '')..'

' else out[#out+1]=''.. '
'..E(q)..'

' end end return #out>0 and table.concat(out) or 'No quests are currently tracked.' end -- clearScrollable was forward-declared above for both Affects and Room renderers -- Both objects and NPCs use the FIRST word following the opening A/An as -- their default MUD keyword. The initial descriptive adjective is often a -- valid keyword on Krynn. Do not scan for verbs or select a later noun. -- For an opening "The", use the first following word as a fallback; otherwise -- use the first word of the line (e.g. "Mahir stands behind ..."). -- The room description itself does not contain authoritative target IDs. local function roomKeyword(raw,kind) local text=tostring(raw or ''):gsub('^%s*%[[^%]]+%]%s*',''):gsub('^%s+',''):gsub('%s+$','') local word=text:match('^[Aa][Nn]?%s+([%a][%w_%-]*)') or text:match('^[Tt][Hh][Ee]%s+([%a][%w_%-]*)') or text:match('^([%a][%w_%-]*)') return word and word:lower() or '' end -- A look line is not an authoritative MUD target ID. Auto-guess a keyword, -- but let the player explicitly override the target for each visible entry. local function roomEntryKey(kind,index) return tostring(kind)..':'..tostring(index) end local function roomActionRows(kind,entries) local result,counts={},{} for index,description in ipairs(entries or {}) do local key=roomEntryKey(kind,index) local keyword=K.roomTargetOverrides[key] or roomKeyword(description,kind) if keyword~='' then counts[keyword]=(counts[keyword] or 0)+1 local target=counts[keyword]>1 and (tostring(counts[keyword])..'.'..keyword) or keyword result[#result+1]={description=description,kind=kind,index=index,target=target,keyword=keyword} else result[#result+1]={description=description,kind=kind,index=index,target=nil,keyword=nil} end end return result end function K.roomSelect(kind,index) local key=roomEntryKey(kind,index) K.roomSelected=(K.roomSelected==key) and nil or key K.renderPanel() end function K.roomSetTarget(kind,index,keyword) if kind~='object' and kind~='npc' then return false end local contents=K.roomContents or {} local entries=kind=='object' and contents.objects or contents.npcs index=tonumber(index) if not index or index%1~=0 or not entries or not entries[index] then return false end keyword=tostring(keyword or ''):lower():match('^%s*(.-)%s*$') if not keyword or not keyword:match('^[%w_%-]+$') then return false end K.roomTargetOverrides[roomEntryKey(kind,index)]=keyword K.roomSelected=roomEntryKey(kind,index) K.renderPanel() return true end function K.roomSend(action,item) if not item or not item.target then cecho('\nCannot identify a target keyword for this room entry.\n') return end local legal={npc={kill=true,fire=true,lore=true,look=true},object={look=true,examine=true,read=true,get=true}} if not (legal[item.kind] and legal[item.kind][action]) then return end -- Explicit click only. No automatic attacks or pickups on a room refresh. local cmd=action..' '..item.target if type(send)=='function' then send(cmd) end end -- Explicitly delete old clickable widgets whenever this scroll panel rerenders. function K.clearRoomWidgets() for _,widget in ipairs(K.roomWidgets or {}) do pcall(function() widget:hide();widget:delete() end) end K.roomWidgets={} end function K.renderInteractiveRoom() if not K.initialized or not K.visible then return end clearScrollable('info') K.clearRoomWidgets() local y=5 local function addLabel(name,html,height,bg,onclick,tooltip) local item=Geyser.Label:new({name='KrynnNativeUI_Room_'..name,x=5,y=y,width='100%-29',height=height},K.infoScroll) item:setStyleSheet('background-color:'..(bg or '#202124')..';color:#eeeeee;border:1px solid #42454b;padding:3px;') item:echo(html) if onclick then item:setClickCallback(onclick) end if tooltip then item:setToolTip(tooltip) end K.roomWidgets[#K.roomWidgets+1]=item y=y+height+3 return item end local function heading(label) addLabel('heading'..y,''..E(label)..'',25,'#292929') end local contents=K.roomContents or {objects={},npcs={},seen=false} if not contents.seen then addLabel('await','Enter a room or use look to capture its contents.',38) else local types={ {label='Objects',kind='object',entries=contents.objects,actions={{'Look','look'},{'Examine','examine'},{'Read','read'},{'Get','get'}}}, {label='NPCs / Characters',kind='npc',entries=contents.npcs,actions={{'Attack','kill'},{'Fire','fire'},{'Lore','lore'},{'Look','look'}}} } for _,group in ipairs(types) do if #group.entries>0 then heading(group.label) for _,entry in ipairs(roomActionRows(group.kind,group.entries)) do local id=group.kind..entry.index local selected=K.roomSelected==roomEntryKey(group.kind,entry.index) local desc=E(entry.description) local rowHeight=math.max(31,math.min(76,27+math.floor(#entry.description/65)*15)) local indicator=selected and '▾' or '▸' addLabel('entity'..id,''..indicator..'
